lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's fifty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 50? Nope!

lines.text: Take away one, or halve and round down. Whoever gets to zero wins.
lines.caption: Take away one, or halve and round down. Whoever gets to zero wins.

lines.text: From one to a hundred, how many starting numbers let player two always win?
lines.caption: From 1 to 100, how many starting numbers let player 2 always win?

lines.text: Red means the player to move loses: two, six, eight, ten, fourteen.
lines.caption: Red means the player to move loses: 2, 6, 8, 10, 14.

lines.text: But four, twelve and sixteen are even AND green! Count their twos.
lines.caption: But 4, 12 and 16 are even AND green! Count their twos.

lines.text: Reds have an ODD number of twos. Eight has three, but four has only two.
lines.caption: Reds have an ODD number of twos. 8 has 3, but 4 has only 2.

lines.text: With one two: twenty-five. With three: six. With five: two. That's thirty-three!
lines.caption: With 1 two: 25. With 3: 6. With 5: 2. That's 33!

lines.text: Did you get thirty-three? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 33? Tell me below!
